runtime_scope: In-process eager finite-cohort open loop. Two real GPUs. Fixed four slots per decoder. DP2 can use both workers for generation. Both PD arms sustain one P and one D.

load_selection.validation: Before seeing candidate traffic results, choose the highest screened load with at least 75% request SLO and a finite completion rate within 85% of the measured planned arrival average. If none pass, choose the lowest load and label the validation quality of the historical SLO.

evaluation: Compare same request IDs and timestamps with natural generation up to tokenizer EOS or cap 2048. Report request SLO-goodput first, plus latency non-regression, batch and outputs. Fraction missed also stays visible when all SLO-goodput is zero.
second_phase: Expand to independent N3 and untouched internal validation only when exact-isolated and practical online gates show a positive result. The pilot is not a sustained-capacity estimate.
